name: parabolic_sar_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, Parabolic SAR flips (from above to below price) mark the moment where directional order-flow imbalance shifts. At 5-second resolution, a SAR flip confirmed by ADX(36) > 20 (3-min trend filter) and price above session VWAP signals that VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms have pivoted to net-buy mode — their execution algorithms are now absorbing sell-side resting orders. The anti-whipsaw filter (fewer than 4 SAR flips in the prior 3 minutes) screens out the range-bound sessions where SAR oscillates uselessly; in genuine trending NIFTY conditions, the confirmed flip initiates a 10-20 spot-point continuation wave over the next 30-90 seconds as the institutional order continues to execute.

indicators.name: psar
indicators.purpose: SAR parameters are ratio-based (not time-based), so no scaling is needed. The af_step=0.02 and af_max=0.20 are kept from original. The SAR's rate of acceleration is proportional to the price move, not bar duration. On 5-second bars, flips occur more frequently due to noise, hence the anti-whipsaw filter.

indicators.name: psar_direction
indicators.purpose: Binary direction for flip detection. A flip is when psar_direction[t] != psar_direction[t-1].

indicators.name: adx_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute ADX. Original used ADX(14) on 1-min bars = 14-minute context window. Compressed to 3 min (36 bars at 5s) because: (a) we hold 15-120s, requiring ADX to respond faster; (b) the original's 14-min ADX was a slow trend filter for 15-60 min holds — proportional scaling for 30-90s holds gives ~3 min; (c) 14×12=168 bars would be a 14-min ADX that is far too slow to reflect the current momentum regime at 5s frequency.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP from 09:15 IST. No scaling needed — it is a session-level anchor. Price above VWAP confirms bullish institutional bias; below VWAP confirms bearish. Same role as original.

indicators.name: vol_avg_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute rolling volume average. Original used SMA(volume,20) on 1-min = 20-minute window. Here we use 60-bar (5-min) window to measure current volume vs recent session activity — shorter than original because at 5s bars, a 20-min average would include too much historical session structure and not reflect the current momentum episode.

indicators.name: flip_count_36
indicators.formula: count of SAR direction changes in last 36 bars (3 min)
indicators.purpose: Anti-whipsaw filter. Original checked > 4 flips in 30 bars (30 min). At 5s, 3 minutes of choppy behavior (36 bars) is sufficient to identify an unreliable SAR regime. If SAR has flipped 4+ times in 3 minutes, the market is range-bound and SAR signals are noise — skip entry.

conditions: psar_direction[t-1] == -1 (SAR just flipped from bear to bull)
close > vwap — price above VWAP confirms institutional buy bias
flip_count_36 < 4 — not in a whipsaw/choppy regime
buy_ce.confirmation: All conditions met on the SAR flip bar itself

conditions: psar_direction[t-1] == +1 (SAR just flipped from bull to bear)
close < vwap — price below VWAP confirms institutional sell bias
flip_count_36 < 4 — not in a whipsaw/choppy regime
buy_pe.confirmation: All conditions met on the SAR flip bar itself

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5. If NIFTY reverses 8 spot pts immediately after a SAR flip, the flip was a false signal — genuine SAR flips in trending conditions should not retrace more than 5-6 spot points within 30 seconds. Using 4 option pts gives a small buffer above the 3-pt false-flip threshold.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts = ~14 NIFTY spot pts. A confirmed SAR flip in a trending session leads to a 10-20 spot point continuation over 30-90 seconds (per typical 30-90s NIFTY move distributions). Targeting 14 pts captures the lower half of expected continuation (conservative but achievable), yielding a 1:1.75 risk-reward.

filters.vix_filter: none — original strategy had no VIX filter; ADX already screens out low-volatility choppy conditions
filters.time_filter: no entries before 09:25 IST (565 min) — skip first 2 minutes of session where SAR is still initializing; no entries after 15:20 IST
filters.trend_filter: ADX(36) > 20 and fewer than 4 SAR flips in prior 36 bars

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — SAR is a well-known indicator; edge comes from the conjunction of SAR flip + ADX + VWAP + anti-whipsaw, which is less commonly traded as a combined system at 5s frequency

adaptation_notes: Key changes from original: (1) Timeframe compressed from 1-min to 5s — SAR parameters unchanged (ratio-based), but ADX period compressed from 14 to 36 bars (14 min → 3 min) proportional to hold time reduction from 15-60 min to 15-120s. (2) Volume filter changed from 20-bar 1-min average to 60-bar 5s average (5-min window, shorter than original's 20-min but appropriate for detecting volume participation in a micro-episode). (3) Anti-whipsaw filter window compressed from 30 bars (30 min original) to 36 bars (3 min at 5s) — we check for recent choppiness, not long-term. (4) Exit: original used SAR as trailing stop (stop-and-reverse); converted to fixed 4-pt stop + 7-pt target with 24-bar time stop because trailing stops are not supported in the pipeline. (5) Universe changed from NIFTY200 stocks to NIFTY index — session 09:25 (not 09:30) because index data is available earlier and SAR initializes faster on a smoother series.
weaknesses: SAR flips at 5s bars are inherently noisy — anti-whipsaw filter helps but cannot eliminate all false signals during NIFTY range sessions
ADX(36) at 5s has a 3-minute initialization lag — first 3 minutes of any trend change may be missed
NIFTY SAR flips can cluster during high-volatility events (FOMC, RBI policy), causing the anti-whipsaw filter to block entries precisely when large moves occur
Fixed stops may be too tight on high-VIX days — consider adding a VIX filter (e.g., skip if VIX > 22) in future versions
